challenge.results: Appending #altered changed the origin digest. The accepted history preserved the original entry and appended the exact unresolved disposition and reason. Substituting Shield would change the candidate ID, publisher key, title, version, path and origin digest. Perimeter’s competition language concerns a product provided to others that competes with the software. Its Notices section addresses recipients of software copies. Neither passage changes the edition binding.

limitations: The two registry revisions share one record lineage. The publisher file establishes the edition label at the pinned revision. The live URL and byte equality across representations were outside this inspection.

Support extends only to recognition of the documentary binding. SPDX equivalence, license selection for a work, exercise of rights, downstream notice compliance and permission to redistribute license text each require separate evidence.
